verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch Community Edition is explicitly documented as free, open-source (MIT-licensed), self-hostable on your own infrastructure with full data ownership, and includes a self-host admin dashboard for managing server configuration. Community sentiment notes some self-host limitations (e.g., desktop app login quirks) and open-core paid tiers for enterprise features like SAML SSO, but the core product is confirmed self-hostable. Missing for 10: independent hands-on report specifically validating a full self-host deployment workflow beyond docs.
